review_method: Actual visual inspection of every whole-page PNG using tools.view_image at high detail, displayed 2-3 pages per call. Native images were 1414x2000 pixels; tool display resized to 1334x1888. This is not a contact-sheet-only or text-extraction-only review.
scope: English manuscript pages 1-20 only; later pages reviewed separately.

pages.observation: Title, author markers and opening abstract readable; no clipping or overlap.
Abstract results, conclusions, keywords and start of background readable.
Background text and citations readable; ordinary paragraph continuation.
Background and study questions readable; stable margins.
Methods heading and study-design text readable.
Figure 1 workflow boxes, arrows, labels and complete caption readable; no clipping.
Data sources and identifiers readable; continuation at page break is intact.
Outcome definition and cohort headings readable.
Cohort and candidate-selection text readable.
Representation definitions, signs and counts readable.
Model and tuning text including formula characters readable.
Nested-validation and final-model text readable.
External-evaluation and tissue-holdout text readable.
Statistical heading and strict-macro rules readable.
Bootstrap/inference text and numeric limits readable.
Statistical continuation and synthetic-methods heading readable.
Reproducibility text, version strings and source hashes readable.
AI-use disclosure and Results opening readable.
Table 1 fits page width, all rows/columns and notes readable; following result heading not orphaned.
Figure 2 labels, confidence bars, axis and complete caption readable; following result text intact.

notes: No visible clipping, text/image overlap, missing-glyph boxes or unreadable table/figure elements identified in the inspected pages. Normal paragraph page breaks retained.
